title: AI-Powered Patient Symptom Simulations for Mental Health Clinician Training
acronym_expansion: Steering-Vector Enhanced LLM Agents for Realistic Patient Symptom Simulations in Mental Health
summary: Large language models steered with Conceptors — advanced steering vectors that allow precise control over how psychiatric symptoms present — giving trainees anywhere access to a wider range of patient presentations than clinics can offer.

aims.primary: Develop and validate STELLAR, a system for training mental health clinicians through realistic, controllable AI-powered patient symptom simulations using LLMs enhanced with Conceptors.
aims.secondary: Use Conceptors to perform robustness analysis of diagnostic tools for depression, anxiety, and psychosis — testing demographic invariance and identifying bias.
aims.exploratory: Evaluate whether fine-tuning multi-speaker TTS models on clinical interview audio improves patient symptom simulation voice authenticity.
